messages:
maya: PR #18902's CI microbench failed — kv-evict-heartbeat test showed +18% p99 latency vs golden. Failing threshold diff attached: https://ci.internal/runs/18902/log

ci-bot: test failed: perf/microbench/kv_evict_heartbeat (threshold_diff=+18.3%)

jon: reproable locally? how noisy is the run

maya: reproduced on my dev image (2 runs). profiler shows a spike in gc/eviction path during kernel selection

liam: can you paste the flamegraph snippet?

maya: 
```
flamegraph snippet:
kv_evict -> eviction_worker -> select_kernel_for_batch
  -> select_fast_kernel (hot) -> sync_wait
  -> fallback_kernel (increased)
```

sara: looks like kernel-autoselect latched to fallback path under certain seq-len distribution. we've seen similar with recent sampler tweak

jon: bisect candidate range? suspecting merge 4fa3c2 (prefetch sampler tweak)

maya: ack. starting bisect in CI.

ci-bot: bisect queued: range 4e900..HEAD, 12 jobs

ops-oncall: putting rollout on hold for this PR and related canaries :no_entry_sign:

liam: quick local check: toggling `PREFETCH_WINDOW=old` drops p99 back to baseline. so sampler change likely

sara: open a revert branch? we'll need a hotfix for dedicated

jon: if revert, let's cherry-pick minimal sampler change. also add a microbench golden for eviction heartbeat

maya: created branch `revert/sampler-prefetch-minimal` and a revert PR. linking here: https://git.internal/r/PR-18910

deploy-bot: deploy hold applied to canary stack 'dedicated-us-west' for builds referencing PR-18902

ci-bot: bisect complete — culprit commit 4fa3c2a1 (sampler: aggressive prefetch heuristic)

sara: agreed, merging revert now. will run canary with improved perf unit tests

jon: also let's add a guard in kernel-autoselect: if kv-evict-rate spikes, force conservative selector for 5 minutes

maya: adding perf test and a regression alert to the PR

liam: thanks — keep me posted on canary metrics

maya: will monitor. thanks team :thumbsup:
